S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  03.01. C528 No.2289 of 2025  2026 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.14 of 2021, "State of Uttarakhand vs. Ankit Agarwal and Others", pending before the court of learned Special Judge (Anti-Corruption)/ IInd Additional District and Sessions Judge, Haldwani, District Nainital under Sections 409, 420, 120B, 466, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 13(1)(d) read with Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Mrs. Sweta Badola Dobhal,
learned Brief Holder for the respondents.
3.

Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate, submitted that the allegation against the applicant is that the applicant, the then District Social Welfare Officer, Nainital, disbursed the scholarship without physical verification of the concerned students.
4. Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate, contended that there was no provision for physical verification of the concerned students of the institute, located outside the State of Uttarakhand.
The institute-in- question was located outside the State of Uttarakhand.
No reliable evidence has been found against the applicant during the investigation to connect the applicant in the present matter.
5. Learned counsel for the respondents has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Till then, the further proceedings of the Special Sessions Trial No.14 of 2021 are stayed qua the applicant - Jagmohan Singh Kafola.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 03.01.2026 Pant/
